vBRIEFInfo.author: agent:deft-directive-setup
vBRIEFInfo.description: Scope: desktop UI — pygame window, event loop, screens, scoreboard

narrative.Overview: Wire together game model, AI, and renderer into a complete pygame application. Handles game mode selection, player turns, result display, scoreboard, and Play Again flow.
narrative.Requirements: FR-1 (window), FR-2 (mode selection), FR-3 (click to play), FR-8 (scoreboard), FR-9 (Play Again), NFR-1 (pygame only).
narrative.Traces: FR-1, FR-2, FR-3, FR-8, FR-9, NFR-1
narrative.Dependencies: Game Model Foundation, AI Engine, Isometric Renderer
narrative.Tasks:
1. main.py: pygame.init(), set window size (e.g. 800×600), title 'Tic-Tac-Toe 3D', main loop.
2. MenuScreen: buttons for 'vs AI' (with Easy/Medium/Hard sub-choice) and '2-Player Hotseat'.
3. GameScreen: render cube via Renderer, display current player turn, scoreboard (Player 1 / Player 2 wins + draws).
4. On click: call hit_test(); if valid cell and correct player's turn, make_move(); check is_winner/is_draw; trigger result overlay.
5. ResultOverlay: 'X wins!' / 'O wins!' / 'Draw!' + Play Again button. Play Again resets board; after 3+ rounds offer 'Back to Menu'.
6. Handle window close event (pygame.QUIT).
7. Smoke test: launch game, click through a full game to completion without crash (manual + a headless pygame test fixture).
narrative.Acceptance: python main.py opens a window. A full game (vs AI, Easy) completes without error. Scoreboard increments correctly. Play Again resets the board.
